description: Request a payout of accumulated earnings to the registered wallet address. Minimum payout is $10. Wallet address must be registered first via register_wallet. Only one payout can be processing at a time. Payouts are approved by an operator and sent in USDC on Base by default.

currency.description: Payout network ticker (default: usdcbase (USDC on Base)). Others: usdcsol, usdcarb, usdcop, usdcmatic, usdc, usdtsol, usdtarb, usdtbsc, usdtmatic, usdterc20, usdtton, usdttrc20

name: request_payout
